envh-01-c3.text: J. R. McNeill (2010). Mosquito Empires: Ecology and War in the Greater Caribbean, 1620-1914. Cambridge University Press.
envh-01-c3.quote: these diseases played partisan roles in the struggles for empire and revolution
envh-01-c3.claim: His Mosquito Empires (2010) turns the lens around: yellow fever and malaria, not just navies, decided the fate of Caribbean colonialism
